newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says copper fundamentals better.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says copper fundamentals better.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) managing director John Prescott said on Friday that fundamentals for the copper market were better than current copper prices indicated.
"We believe the fundamentals for the copper market are somewhat better than the market pricing indicate," Prescott told a news conference.
Prescott said it was likely the copper market had felt the full impact of Sumitomo Corp's losses from alleged rogue copper trades.

"We believe the effect of the Sumitomo issue has been worked through the market but until the market's confident of that, until it's clear what the future trends of supply and demand are going to be...we're not going to know," he said.
BHP's copper division earlier reported a 55.5 percent fall in profit to A$85 million for the three months to August 31.
BHP's average price booked for copper shipments in the first quarter was $0.95 per pound down from $1.36 a year earlier.
BHP became the world's second largest copper producer when it bought U.S. copper producer Magma Copper Co for US$2.4 billion earlier this year.
BHP shares closed five cents lower at A$16.04.
